studioLead: Curate useful products for your audience, add your personality and earn support from purchases.
independent: Enable just a promo code, just a storefront, or both.
promoHelp: Your code supports you on any eligible marketplace product. The buyer pays the ordinary price; the seller funds support. Storefront rates are higher.
promoRules: 3–24 Latin letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. The code must be available.
headline: Headline
empty: Nothing here yet. Find your first product above.
noResults: No products match these filters yet.
beforeFees: Before platform and payment fees and taxes. This is a calculation, not a payout.
priceInsufficient: There are too few independent sellers for a price reference.
unmatched: All variant details are required for an exact comparison.
priceExplanation: We compare the same variant and currency. Each seller counts once; stale prices and extreme outliers are excluded.
above_observed_price: The price is above comparable offers. A high support rate does not guarantee a sale.
verify_terms_and_seller: A high rate at an ordinary or low price: check the seller, terms and delivery carefully. This is a prompt to verify, not an accusation.
conversionEmpty: Not estimated yet: there is insufficient history of unique views and completed purchases.
statsEmpty: Actual order results will appear here. No data yet.
mock: Local test environment: amounts are not real payouts.
error: Could not load data. Please try again.
conflict: Settings changed in another tab or the code is taken. Refresh the data; your draft is still here.
needLogin: Sign in to set up your page.
needCreator: Create a creator profile first. Your storefront and promo tools will appear here.
draft: Your profile is not published yet. Settings will be saved; the public page will appear after publication.
configureLead: Accurate details help buyers find your product and compare genuinely equivalent offers.
identityHelp: An empty field means unknown: these variants are not automatically merged. Use standard or global only when those values match the actual terms. Steam IDs: app/123 (game), sub/123 (package) or bundle/123. Publisher IDs need a namespace: vendor.example:asset-123.
restricted: This format is modelled for the future catalog. Publication remains closed pending policy and payment review.
ratesHelp: Both rates are required: storefront above promo, maximum 50%. The buyer pays the ordinary price.
readOnly: Details and rates are locked after submission for moderation.
equivalents: The same product from other sellers
noEquivalents: No exact equivalents yet. Keys, gifts and accounts are compared separately.
choose: The storefront and promo code belong to different creators. Choose one.
supportHelp: Funded by the seller. Your price stays the same. Support accrues after the deal completes.
quoteError: Support could not be confirmed. Check the code and storefront, or choose to purchase without support.
configureBeforeSubmit: Configure the variant and both support rates below first.
sellerToolsLead: Compare only equivalent variants and see your proceeds after creator support.
rateNotConfigured: Creator support is not configured by the seller yet.
uploadHelp: PNG or JPEG up to 10 MB. We resize it for fast loading. The image becomes public after saving it to a published storefront.
uploadError: Could not upload the image. Check its format, size and connection.
priceLimited: There are too many offers for a complete calculation right now. We do not show a reference from an incomplete sample.
quoteChanged: The price or support terms have changed. Review the updated quote and confirm the terms again.
